title: Machine learning-based prediction of severe Mycoplasma pneumoniae pneumonia in pediatric patients.
summary: LASSO selected clinical variables and eight algorithms were compared; random forest had accuracy .92, specificity .91, recall .91 and F1 .91 in 407 children with mild or severe M. pneumoniae pneumonia.
ai_technology: LASSO, eight machine-learning classifiers, best-performing random forest and SHAP interpretation.
organization: Not stated in the abstract reviewed

evidence.unknown: Retrospective 407-patient cohort; no external or prospective validation or treatment benefit shown.
